units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>שרתי</he>, v. <cite ref="L00579"><he>לָמַס</he></cite> a. <cite ref="M01825"><he>מַסָּא</he> I</cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="M01245"><he>מִסִּים</he></cite>, <cite ref="M01245"><he>מִסִּין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:1:18">Y. Dem. II, 22ᵈ</cite> top <he>מעלי מ׳ כמי שנתכבשו</he> the places which were made tributary (under Joshua) are considered as conquered (belonging to the Holy Land); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 6:1:13">Y. Shebi. VI, 36ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>בעלי סיסין</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:12">Gen. R. s. 98</cite>.
Lev. R. s. 33, end לא למסגד אלא למפלח במ׳ וכ׳ (this ועבדתם, Deut. IV, 28) does not mean ‘to worship’ but ‘to serve’ by paying imposts, annonae &c.

<cite ref="Deuteronomy 4:28">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:14">Cant. R. to II, 14</cite> <he>אם למ׳ … את מלך עלינו וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>לפסים</he>) if it be a question of taxes … thou art king over us … (we recognize thy sovereignty) …, but &c.
